published.source: Tauren, Nature's Focus pushback and the client 70425 racials (2026-10-16)

summary: Shred and Rip cat with Shifting Power for Energy and Berserk on cooldown, no Rake. Under Forever the cat swings at its weapon's DPS at 1.0 s, and stones, potions, Thistle Tea and Windfury Totem work in Cat Form. The default Feral build.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form (no Stealth/Prowl or Ravage)
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown; Berserk with the on-use trinket
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 CP and Rip has 6 s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2 s
Rip at 4+ combo points when it is down (not in the last 8 s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6 s or more left (or in the last 8 s)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 29 Agility and 17 Strength, and an on-use 165 Strength for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Rip's level 31+ client ranks are 6-9% below Era. Era values would give +1.6%.
Howling Idol (0.5 s off Shifting Power since client 1.60.1.70425) is worth 4.8 at 180 s; 5-piece Grovekeeper Ferocity would add 5.9 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, AP on Rip and Ferocious Bite, Rend and Tear's scope
Keeping Rake up costs 33 DPS. Rip at 5 CP ties.
One +2% crit elixir per character. Grizzly in place of Ferocity would add 4.9.
Tiger's Fury is gone in Forever (replaced by Shifting Power). It was worth 24.9 at 180 s.
The cat's swing damage spreads 20% either side of the weapon's DPS (the server's range isn't known).

Windfury Totem and a second shaman's Grace of Air in the melee group (they stack since client 70425). Dense Weightstone on the mace adds 4.9. Elemental Sharpening Stone is left out (plans only from Molten Core).
notes: Request from mksettings -spec feral (melee group: Strength of Earth and Windfury Totem, all blessings, own Leader of the Pack; latency 100 ms). Duration 180 s, durationVariation 20. Forever lets the cat drink in form, so Mighty Rage Potion and Thistle Tea are used. No edits needed.
